_comment: Measured calibration of the REAL chair (３階講堂遠隔操作席) sit task, for the g1-isu RL pipeline. All numbers probe-measured in MuJoCo on 2026-06-11 with the mesh-calibrated G1 pelvis proxy (bottom = base-0.155 m). Chair frame: origin = chair_info origin, sitter faces +y.
_seat_note: chair_info.json says 0.6483 (bbox-based); a downward raycast onto the cushion hulls gives 0.635 — use the raycast value for contact-relevant targets.
_height_note: 0.415 > 0.39: the G1 cannot sit fully flat on this seat from a soft-gain descent (perches at pelvis pitch ~+16 deg). A STIFF-gain descent (kp=300) slides ~20 cm deep onto the cushion and lands flat (pitch ~0).

sit_pelvis_target._frame: chair frame, base (pelvis) position when seated

_sit_target_note: g1-isu config.py uses sit_target = seat_center + 0.10 m z-offset => z 0.748 at y -0.103. MEASURED stable seated base is y +0.085, z 0.800 (the pelvis CENTER sits ~0.165 above the cushion top because the pelvis bottom is 0.155 below the base origin). Recommend updating the reward target to (0.0, 0.085, 0.80).

gains._note: SIT-mode leg gains; walking keeps the walk-policy gains. Same mode-switch mechanism as pretrained_walker.py (kp=500).

platform_start_basin._frame: spawn standing on the platform, facing +y, base position

seated_state.support_path: pelvis box + both thighs on the cushion; feet stay on the footrest platform; armrests untouched

reward_shaping_hints: yaw budget is TIGHT: static descents survive +-10 deg but 15 deg topples (armrest/cushion-edge interaction) — penalize |yaw - pi/2| beyond ~0.15 rad strongly
away-from-seat drift at descent start is unrecoverable (sat into empty air at 0.12 m/s); toward-seat drift is safe (the seat catches it) — asymmetric velocity shaping
the cushion front edge (y ~0.15, curved hulls) deflects landings sideways: reward deep landings (pelvis y < 0.12) over edge perches
feet must stay on the platform (y in [0.20, 0.50]): a heel past y<0.20 hangs off the edge
demos: demos/real_chair_sit/demo_*.npz — 30 successful platform-start sits, 50 Hz (qpos nq=36, qvel nv=35, ctrl nu=29, dt, spawn offsets, sit gains). State-level (gain-agnostic); replay/relabel in the g1-isu env for BC/DeepMimic-style imitation.
